profile.campus: Data4 Warsaw campus, Jawczyce, Poland (WAW1 and WAW2, combined ~4 hectares / 60 MW per Data4 own site)
profile.reading:
WAW1 is DATA4's first Polish data center, at Przyparkowa 21, in the village of Jawczyce within the Ożarów Mazowiecki municipality, about 20 minutes from central Warsaw. DATA4, a French headquartered data center developer and operator founded in 2006 and based in Paris, opened WAW1 on May 26, 2023, its first facility outside France, Italy, and Spain and the first building on what has since grown into a two building Warsaw campus alongside a sister facility, WAW2. DATA4's Poland entity, DATA4 Poland Sp. z o.o., appears in the Polish national court register under number 0000870360, registered November 30, 2020, at this same Przyparkowa 21 address, wholly owned by DATA4 Services Poland Sp. z o.o., with DATA4 group chief executive Olivier Micheli listed as a board member since December 2022.

At opening, WAW1 carried 8 megawatts of IT power, DATA4 described it as ready to receive its first clients, and the building incorporated a set of environmental measures the company highlighted publicly, including optimized low carbon concrete mixes, materials sourced locally or moved by rail rather than road, hot aisle containment, plastic rather than steel piping for cooling loops, free cooling and free chilling, and a company built Green Dashboard tool for tenants to track the environmental footprint of their rented capacity. DATA4's own current Warsaw campus page states the finished campus, WAW1 and WAW2 combined, will occupy about 4 hectares and offer roughly 60 megawatts of available IT power, without breaking that total down building by building, so no campus wide utility interconnection, standby generation, or onsite generation figure beyond available IT power was found published for this site.

No environmental decision document, in Polish a decyzja o środowiskowych uwarunkowaniach, and no equivalent gmina level planning record specific to WAW1 was located on the Ożarów Mazowiecki municipal public information bulletin or through a search of Polish environmental review terminology during this research, despite WAW1 and WAW2 clearly having gone through some form of Polish construction and environmental permitting to be built and connected to the grid. What was found instead is an October 2025 agreement between DATA4 and the Ożarów Mazowiecki municipal government, fully funded by DATA4, to repave and light Przyparkowa street from its junction with Sadowa street to the S8 highway overpass, the road serving the campus, with DATA4's Poland director explicitly citing the company's plan to keep building additional data centers at this location as the reason for funding the road work.

DATA4's global ownership has changed twice since WAW1 opened. AXA Investment Managers Alternatives sold DATA4 to Brookfield Infrastructure in a deal completed in August 2023 for 2.4 billion dollars, and in August 2025 Brookfield brought in Arjun Infrastructure Partners and Interogo Holding as new shareholders. DATA4's own August 2025 press release on that transaction names Paris, Milan, and Madrid, not Warsaw, as the cities inside the divested 244 megawatt stabilised portfolio, consistent with Poland remaining one of DATA4's newer, still expanding markets rather than part of the assets being sold down to new investors. No tenant name for WAW1 was found in any source reviewed.

profile.capacity_note: Operator states campus wide totals of approximately 4 hectares and 60 MW of available IT power for the shared WAW1 and WAW2 campus, not broken down by individual building, so not attributed to this specific record.
profile.research_note: Rewritten 2026-09-05: prior version carried a stale 2019-era AXA-only ownership claim. Extended ownership history through the April 2023/August 2023 Brookfield acquisition and the August 2025 Arjun Infrastructure Partners / Interogo Holding stake sale, sourced to DATA4 own press release and a DCD article, noting that release names only Paris, Milan and Madrid, not Warsaw, in the divested stabilised portfolio. Added WAW1 8MW IT power figure and full opening detail from ITwiz (Polish trade press), and confirmed the Data4 Poland Sp. z o.o. KRS registration (0000870360, since Nov 2020) at this exact address via Polish national court register data. Searched Ożarów Mazowiecki gmina BIP and Polish environmental-review terminology (decyzja środowiskowa, karta informacyjna przedsięwzięcia) for a facility-specific environmental decision or PSE grid interconnection filing, found none this session, recorded here as an explicit gap rather than left silent. Found and cited an October 2025 DATA4-funded municipal road agreement as the clearest local government record tying the company to this address. No banned aggregator used as a source.
profile.campus_power_note: The four power numbers for DATA4's Warsaw campus need to stay separate because only IT power figures were found published, and no campus wide building count total was found. DATA4's own current Warsaw page states the finished WAW1 and WAW2 campus will total about 60 megawatts of available IT power across roughly 4 hectares, without a building by building breakdown. Trade press reported WAW1's IT power at 8 megawatts when it opened in May 2023, and WAW2's IT power at 10 megawatts when it launched in April 2026, together 18 megawatts committed against that 60 megawatt campus target, implying further building phases beyond WAW1 and WAW2 that no source reviewed this session named or dated, so campus_buildings_total is left unset rather than guessed. No standby generator rating, utility grid interconnection figure, or onsite generation figure was found published for this campus in any DATA4, Polish grid operator, or municipal source located during this research.
